authorizedScopeWhenApproved: authenticate the selected production host to private GHCR without logging the token
pull only the approved exact digest
render and review the final Compose configuration without printing secrets
start or replace the backend service with one replica and one worker
run non-mutating application and managed-database health checks
verify the existing reverse proxy route and HTTPS endpoint
excludedScope: database create, reset, seed, restore, write, or destructive query
Alembic revision, autogenerate, stamp, upgrade, or downgrade
automatic image reference updates or automatic deployment
Docker volume deletion or docker compose down -v
secret, token, password, CA, certificate, or private-key disclosure

requiredInputs.requiredValue: provider, region, operating system, linux/amd64 Docker host, and access method
provider, product, region, endpoint hostname, database name, user, and connectivity policy
provider-authenticated CA PEM and approved host mount path
proxy product or managed ingress, domain, DNS ownership, certificate issuance, and renewal owner
non-repository secret store or host-only protected env path for database, JWT, and admin keys
pre-created Docker network name shared only with the selected reverse proxy
managed database backup status and first-deploy traffic rollback owner

orderedExecution: read-only preflight of host architecture, Docker, disk, clock, and outbound GHCR access
verify every required input and secret source without printing values
reconfirm the exact image digest and signature evidence
authenticate GHCR on the selected host using the approved non-logged credential path
pull the exact digest and verify local RepoDigests and linux/amd64 platform
verify the pre-created edge network and provider CA file permissions
render final Compose config through the sanitized wrapper and stop on placeholders or drift
start the backend service without host ports, database service, volume, or migration
wait for /api/v1/health and inspect non-root, read-only, limits, and exact image digest
run /api/v1/health/db as a read-only connectivity check only after verify-full TLS is confirmed
verify the existing reverse proxy route and public HTTPS origin without changing game data
record sanitized evidence and leave automatic deployment disabled

rollback.onPreTrafficFailure: remove only the new backend container and keep database, CA, network, and volumes untouched
rollback.onPostTrafficFailure: withdraw the proxy route, stop the new backend, preserve logs without secrets, and investigate before retry
rollback.databaseRollback: not applicable because this plan performs no schema or data mutation
